description: Tricky messages: good news about a topic that is usually a problem (passed the defense, made up with a friend), failed exams/defense, wanting to share or vent, and casual hellos. None of these sentences are training patterns, but the first 60 were looked at while choosing new training phrasings, so they are not fully unseen. Scored with: python evaluate.py --test tests/good_news_set.json
